name: Ham
siboNotes: Plain ham is naturally FODMAP-free, but check labels for added high-FODMAP ingredients like honey, garlic, or onion powder.
preparationTips: Choose plain, minimally processed ham without added sweeteners or seasonings
Read labels carefully - avoid varieties with honey, garlic powder, or onion powder
Rinse canned or packaged ham to reduce excess sodium if needed
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables for balanced meals
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially B12
Good source of zinc and selenium
Contains iron for healthy blood cells
